description: Emit str-valued prompt assets for LLM / agent demos. Five modes: literal {key: text} map, template+topics, fixed single, composed (systematic composition from persona/style/length/task_type/format_hint/depth levers, no LLM), or LLM (LiteLLM-elevated paraphraser using the same levers as natural-language hints). Sibling of synthetic_image_generator / synthetic_audio_generator / synthetic_pdf_generator / synthetic_video_generator.

outputs.description: One str-valued asset. Partitioned in modes A/B/D/E, unpartitioned in mode C.

template.label: Template
template.description: Mode B: template rendered per topic. `{topic}` / `{partition_key}` substituted. Requires `topics:`.

topics.label: Topics
topics.description: List of topics. Used by modes B / D / E. In modes D/E, each topic expands into `count_per_topic` variants. Partition keys are `{topic}` when count=1, `{topic}__v{n}` (0-indexed) when >1.

persona.label: Persona
persona.description: Lever (modes D/E): who's asking. Sets prompt opener persona.

length.label: Length
length.description: Lever (modes D/E): requested answer length hint.

task_type.label: Task Type
task_type.description: Lever (modes D/E): verb + framing of the prompt.

depth.label: Depth
depth.description: Lever (modes D/E): assumed background level of the reader.

count_per_topic.label: Count Per Topic
count_per_topic.description: Modes D/E: number of variants per topic. Emits partition keys `{topic}__v{n}` when >1.

seed.label: Seed
seed.description: Reproducibility seed for mode D (composed picking) and mode E (LLM seed hint).

paraphrase_model.label: Paraphrase Model
paraphrase_model.description: Mode E: LiteLLM model string (e.g. 'gpt-4o-mini', 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001'). Presence triggers LLM mode.

api_key_env_var.label: API Key Env Var
api_key_env_var.description: Mode E: env var holding the LLM provider's API key.

api_base_env_var.label: API Base Env Var
api_base_env_var.description: Mode E: env var holding a custom API base URL.

system_prompt.label: System Prompt
system_prompt.description: Mode E: override the default paraphraser system prompt.

max_tokens.label: Max Tokens
max_tokens.description: Mode E: max completion tokens per variant.

include_wrong_variants.label: Include Wrong Variants
include_wrong_variants.description: Mode E: pepper adversarial / under-specified variants (every 3rd) for downstream robustness / eval flows.
